subject: Hybrid Workshop — master bill split, swapboard & accessibility matrix

Subject: Hybrid Workshop — master bill split, swapboard & accessibility matrix

Hi Elena,

We're confirming the room block for Redwood Inference + Acme Corp for the week of Aug 9–12 (exec workshop + 2x breakout days). A few coordination asks so ops can finalize travel: 

- Master bill: we need an itemized split on the master bill so Redwood covers meeting room F&B and AV, while Acme covers guest room charges. Can you confirm you can produce a split invoice by cost center (i.e., separate subtotal lines and one consolidated PDF)?
- Accessibility matrix: we have three wheelchair-accessible rooms, two hearing-impaired kits, and one ADA roll-in shower request. I'll attach an accessibility_matrix.pdf with the names. Please confirm room numbers reserved for these.
- Swapboard: a few execs will want room swaps on arrival day (late arrivals with specific quiet-floor requests). We'll provide a rooming_list_v3.xlsx (prelim) — want a simple mechanism (email thread or hotel swapboard sheet) for day-of swaps and a point of contact at the desk.
- Late check-in: estimate ~8 arrivals after 11pm on Mon Aug 9. Please confirm late check-in policy and any late-arrival fees or key-holding procedures.
- Shuttle & parking: confirm shuttle windows to airport (if available) and blocked parking passes for 12 cars.

Attached: rooming_list_v3.xlsx (prelim), accessibility_matrix.pdf.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Events & Executive Ops | Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 415-555-0128
From: Elena Morales <bookings@grandharborhotel.com>

Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid Workshop — master bill split, swapboard & accessibility matrix

Hi Tessa,

Thanks — happy to help. Quick answers and open items below: 

1) Master bill: yes, we can produce an itemized master bill split by payer. We bill rooms to the rooming party (Acme) and meeting/AV/F&B to Redwood per your instructions. We will provide a consolidated PDF plus two line-item exports (CSV).
2) Accessibility: we can hold the 3 wheelchair rooms and 2 hearing kits now. Please confirm the specific guest names by Jul 24 so we can tag room keys and accessible parking.
3) Swapboard: we maintain a day-of swap list at bell/concierge (we can share a shared Google sheet or run swaps via a single hotel phone number). Point person at the desk will be Miguel Rojas (miguel.rojas@grandharborhotel.com). He will staff late arrivals from 9pm–2am.
4) Late check-in: no additional fee for arrivals before 2:30am for a group block, but we will require credit card guarantees for any incidental charges.
5) Shuttle & parking: airport shuttle runs 6:30–10:30am and 3:30–7:45pm; we can add one evening 11:00pm pickup on request (fee applies). We'll reserve 12 parking passes on a master-bill basis.

Attached: preliminary block rates and meeting room AV rider. A couple of open items: do you need early breakfast setup in the main ballroom on Aug 10 (6:45am)? Also, do any attendees require kosher/halal meal prep?

Best,
Elena

--
Elena Morales
Senior Sales Manager — Grand Harbor Hotel
bookings@grandharborhotel.com | +1 206-555-0199

Subject: Re: Hybrid Workshop — master bill split, swapboard & accessibility matrix

Tessa — thanks for the update and Elena for the quick answers. A couple internal clarifications from our side to make the hotel's requests actionable: 

- Accessibility names: attaching my quick list here (will push final names by Jul 24). Note: attendee Jana Ortiz requires roll-in shower; Amir Shah needs hearing kit.
- Swapboard process: recommend we maintain two lists — (A) Preassigned swaps (we'll email the hotel by 10am Aug 9) and (B) Day-of swapboard at the bell desk for any minor re-assignments. Miguel should be the single escalation.
- Early breakfast: yes, please confirm early coffee + grab-and-go pastries in the ballroom starting 6:45am on Aug 10. Redwood covers that on the meeting master.
- Dietary: Acme flagged 3 vegetarian, 1 pescatarian, 2 gluten-free. Laura will consolidate and send a final dietary matrix by Jul 10.

Also — regarding the swapboard and quiet-floor requests, can we reserve 6 rooms on the 11th floor as a quiet wing? If hotel can tag those as 'Do Not Disturb' for group housekeeping the night before, that would help late-arrivals.

On the master bill split, quick ask: can the hotel provide a one-page reconciliation (rooms vs meeting charges) two business days after checkout? That helps accounting reallocation.

Thanks — L

--
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Events | Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — final confirmations below so ops can lock travel: 

1) Accessibility: confirmed. We will submit final names for the 3 wheelchair rooms and 2 hearing kits by Jul 24.
2) Quiet wing: reserve 6 rooms on 11th floor as requested; Miguel please mark as 'quiet wing' and 'Do Not Disturb' for housekeeping on Aug 8.
3) Master bill: Elena — please provide the two-line CSV export (rooms vs meeting/AV/F&B) and one consolidated PDF invoice two business days after checkout (Aug 14). TravelOps will handle reconciliation.
4) Late arrivals & swapboard: TravelOps to run the day-of swapboard; Miguel will be the day contact. Sarah — please send pre-check-in emails to the late arrivals on Aug 8.
5) Early breakfast: yes, 6:45am coffee/pastries in the ballroom on Aug 10 (Redwood to cover).
6) Parking & shuttle: 12 parking passes reserved; one 11pm shuttle pickup can be added (we'll confirm by Jul 20).

Attachments: final rooming_list_v3.xlsx (attached) and accessibility_matrix.pdf (attached).

Elena — please reply here with the confirmation that the quiet-wing hold and the master-bill reconciliation plan are set; then we'll mark travel as locked.

Thanks — Tessa
